`crates/opl-api/src/power_fence.rs`를 만든다:

```rust
//! 노드 전원 끄기 펜싱의 실행기(설계 §8.1). `NodeFence`의 방법(IPMI·Redfish·명령)으로 노드를 끄고 전원을 읽는다.
//! 리더가 리스를 잃은 노드를 끌 때([`power_off`])와 `fence-test`·이웃 확인([`check`])이 쓴다. 오류는 모든 뷰어가 읽는
//! `fence_check`·`node-power-off` Task로 가므로 일반 이유만 담는다(BMC 주소·호스트·명령 출력 없이). 자세한 것은 경고
//! 로그에 남긴다.

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use opl_cluster::Cluster;
use opl_types::fence::{
    CommandFence, FenceKind, FenceMethod, FenceMethodStatus, IpmiFence, NodeFenceSpec, Power,
    RedfishFence,
};
use opl_types::node::{Node, NodeSpec};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

/// 명령 하나·HTTP 요청 하나를 기다리는 최대 시간
pub const FENCE_CALL_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);
/// 끄기 뒤 꺼진 것을 확인하기까지 기다리는 최대 시간
pub const FENCE_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);
/// 끄기 뒤 전원을 다시 읽는 간격
const CONFIRM_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
/// 경고 로그에 남기는 실패한 명령 출력의 최대 길이
const OUTPUT_LIMIT: usize = 400;
/// 명령 출력을 받아 두는 최대 크기
const OUTPUT_CAPTURE: usize = 64 * 1024;
/// 명령이 끝난 뒤 출력의 끝(EOF)을 기다리는 시간. 출력 파이프를 쥔 채 남은 백그라운드 자식이 있으면 그때까지
/// 받은 것만 쓴다.
const OUTPUT_GRACE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
/// orbivisord에 `PATH`가 없을 때 명령 방법에 주는 `PATH`
const DEFAULT_PATH: &str = "/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin";

/// 방법 하나로 노드를 끄고 전원을 읽는다.
#[async_trait]
pub trait PowerFence: Send + Sync {
    /// 끄기를 요청한다(꺼졌는지는 [`status`](Self::status)로 본다).
    async fn off(&self, node: &Node, method: &FenceMethod) -> Result<(), String>;
    async fn status(&self, node: &Node, method: &FenceMethod) -> Result<Power, String>;
}

/// 실제 실행기: `ipmitool`, Redfish(HTTP), `/bin/sh -c`
pub struct Fencer {
    /// `ipmitool` 실행 파일(opld `[ha] ipmitool`)
    pub ipmitool: PathBuf,
    /// 명령 하나·HTTP 요청 하나의 제한 시간
    pub timeout: Duration,
}

impl Default for Fencer {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            ipmitool: "ipmitool".into(),
            timeout: FENCE_CALL_TIMEOUT,
        }
    }
}

/// 끄기의 결과
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PowerOff {
    /// 이 방법으로 꺼진 것을 확인했다.
    Off { method: FenceKind },
    /// 모든 방법이 실패했다(방법마다 `"<종류>: <이유>"`).
    Failed(Vec<String>),
}

/// `spec`의 방법을 차례로 해 본다: 끄기를 요청하고 1초마다 전원을 읽어 [`FENCE_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT`] 안에 꺼지면
/// 끝, 아니면 다음 방법.
pub async fn power_off(fence: &dyn PowerFence, node: &Node, spec: &NodeFenceSpec) -> PowerOff {
    power_off_within(fence, node, spec, FENCE_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT).await
}

/// [`power_off`]와 같되 꺼진 것을 `confirm`까지 기다린다(시험이 짧게 쓴다). 끄기 요청이 실패해도 전원을 한 번
/// 읽어 꺼져 있으면 그 방법으로 꺼진 것으로 본다(이미 꺼진 노드에 409를 주는 BMC, 꺼지며 끊긴 호스트).
pub async fn power_off_within(
    fence: &dyn PowerFence,
    node: &Node,
    spec: &NodeFenceSpec,
    confirm: Duration,
) -> PowerOff {
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    for method in &spec.methods {
        let kind = method.kind().as_str();
        if let Err(e) = fence.off(node, method).await {
            if fence.status(node, method).await == Ok(Power::Off) {
                return PowerOff::Off {
                    method: method.kind(),
                };
            }
            errors.push(format!("{kind}: {e}"));
            continue;
        }
        match confirm_off(fence, node, method, confirm).await {
            Ok(()) => {
                return PowerOff::Off {
                    method: method.kind(),
                };
            }
            Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{kind}: {e}")),
        }
    }
    PowerOff::Failed(errors)
}

/// 꺼질 때까지 전원을 읽는다. 마지막으로 읽은 것을 오류에 담는다.
async fn confirm_off(
    fence: &dyn PowerFence,
    node: &Node,
    method: &FenceMethod,
    confirm: Duration,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + confirm;
    loop {
        let last = match fence.status(node, method).await {
            Ok(Power::Off) => return Ok(()),
            Ok(power) => format!("power is {}", power_str(power)),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        if tokio::time::Instant::now() + CONFIRM_INTERVAL > deadline {
            return Err(format!(
                "power off not confirmed within {}s ({last})",
                confirm.as_secs()
            ));
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(CONFIRM_INTERVAL).await;
    }
}

fn power_str(power: Power) -> &'static str {
    match power {
        Power::On => "on",
        Power::Off => "off",
        Power::Unknown => "unknown",
    }
}

/// 방법마다 전원을 읽는다(함께, 방법 순서로). 전원은 건드리지 않는다.
pub async fn check(
    fence: &dyn PowerFence,
    node: &Node,
    spec: &NodeFenceSpec,
) -> Vec<FenceMethodStatus> {
    futures_util::future::join_all(spec.methods.iter().map(|method| async move {
        match fence.status(node, method).await {
            Ok(power) => FenceMethodStatus {
                kind: method.kind(),
                power,
                error: None,
            },
            Err(e) => FenceMethodStatus {
                kind: method.kind(),
                power: Power::Unknown,
                error: Some(e),
            },
        }
    }))
    .await
}

/// 다른 노드가 노드 사이 RPC(`FenceStatus`)로 부탁한 전원 읽기. 이 노드 저장소의 `NodeFence`를 쓴다.
pub struct FenceStatusSource {
    pub cluster: Arc<Cluster>,
    pub fence: Arc<dyn PowerFence>,
}

#[async_trait]
impl opl_peer::FenceSource for FenceStatusSource {
    async fn status(&self, node: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<FenceMethodStatus>, String> {
        let target = self
            .cluster
            .get::<NodeSpec>(node)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("node {node} not found"))?;
        let spec = self
            .cluster
            .get::<NodeFenceSpec>(node)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("node {:?} has no power fencing", target.name))?;
        Ok(check(self.fence.as_ref(), &target, &spec.spec).await)
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl PowerFence for Fencer {
    async fn off(&self, node: &Node, method: &FenceMethod) -> Result<(), String> {
        let call = async {
            match method {
                FenceMethod::Ipmi(ipmi) => self.ipmi(ipmi, "off").await.map(drop),
                FenceMethod::Redfish(redfish) => self.redfish_off(redfish).await,
                FenceMethod::Command(command) => run_shell(node, &command.off).await.map(drop),
            }
        };
        self.limited(call).await
    }

    async fn status(&self, node: &Node, method: &FenceMethod) -> Result<Power, String> {
        let call = async {
            match method {
                FenceMethod::Ipmi(ipmi) => {
                    self.ipmi(ipmi, "status").await.map(|out| ipmi_power(&out))
                }
                FenceMethod::Redfish(redfish) => self.redfish_status(redfish).await,
                FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence { status, .. }) => {
                    run_shell(node, status).await.map(|out| command_power(&out))
                }
            }
        };
        self.limited(call).await
    }
}

impl Fencer {
    /// `call`을 제한 시간까지만 기다린다. 넘으면 버린다(명령은 `kill_on_drop`으로 끝난다).
    async fn limited<T>(&self, call: impl Future<Output = Result<T, String>>) -> Result<T, String> {
        tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, call)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| Err(format!("timed out after {}s", self.timeout.as_secs())))
    }

    /// `ipmitool … chassis power <action>`의 표준 출력. 비밀번호는 `IPMI_PASSWORD` 환경 변수로 넘긴다.
    async fn ipmi(&self, ipmi: &IpmiFence, action: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
        let mut command = tokio::process::Command::new(&self.ipmitool);
        command.args(ipmi_args(ipmi, action)).env("LANG", "C");
        match &ipmi.password {
            Some(password) => command.env("IPMI_PASSWORD", password),
            None => command.env_remove("IPMI_PASSWORD"),
        };
        output(command, "ipmitool").await
    }

    /// Redfish 요청용 HTTP 클라이언트. `ca_pem`이 있으면 그 인증서만 루트로 믿고 `insecure`면 확인하지 않는다.
    /// 리다이렉트를 따르지 않는다(Basic 인증을 다른 곳으로 보내지 않게). BMC는 관리망에 있으므로 프록시 환경
    /// 변수(`HTTP(S)_PROXY`)를 따르지 않는다.
    fn redfish_client(&self, redfish: &RedfishFence) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
        let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .timeout(self.timeout)
            .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
            .no_proxy();
        if let Some(pem) = &redfish.ca_pem {
            let certs = reqwest::Certificate::from_pem_bundle(pem.as_bytes())
                .map_err(|e| format!("ca_pem: {}", crate::telemetry::chain(&e)))?;
            builder = builder.tls_certs_only(certs);
        }
        if redfish.insecure {
            builder = builder.tls_danger_accept_invalid_certs(true);
        }
        builder.build().map_err(|e| crate::telemetry::chain(&e))
    }

    /// 시스템 리소스의 URL. `system_id`가 없으면 `Systems`의 멤버가 하나일 때 그것이다. 멤버는 `url`과 같은 출처
    /// (scheme·호스트·포트)여야 한다(Basic 인증을 다른 곳으로 보내지 않게).
    async fn redfish_system(
        &self,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        redfish: &RedfishFence,
    ) -> Result<reqwest::Url, String> {
        let base = redfish.url.trim_end_matches('/');
        if let Some(id) = &redfish.system_id {
            return parse_url(&format!("{base}/redfish/v1/Systems/{id}"));
        }
        let systems = parse_url(&format!("{base}/redfish/v1/Systems"))?;
        let list =
            redfish_json(client, redfish, reqwest::Method::GET, systems.clone(), None).await?;
        let members = list["Members"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let host = host_port(&systems);
        let [member] = members.as_slice() else {
            return Err(format!(
                "the BMC lists {} systems; set system_id",
                members.len()
            ));
        };
        let path = member["@odata.id"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or_else(|| "the BMC lists a system without @odata.id".to_string())?;
        let system = systems.join(path).map_err(|e| {
            tracing::warn!(bmc = %host, path, error = %e, "the BMC lists a bad system path");
            "the BMC lists a bad system path".to_string()
        })?;
        if system.origin() != systems.origin() {
            tracing::warn!(bmc = %host, path, "the BMC lists a system on another host");
            return Err("the BMC lists a system on another host".into());
        }
        Ok(system)
    }

    async fn redfish_off(&self, redfish: &RedfishFence) -> Result<(), String> {
        let client = self.redfish_client(redfish)?;
        let system = self.redfish_system(&client, redfish).await?;
        let reset = parse_url(&format!(
            "{}/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset",
            system.as_str().trim_end_matches('/')
        ))?;
        redfish_json(
            &client,
            redfish,
            reqwest::Method::POST,
            reset,
            Some(json!({ "ResetType": "ForceOff" })),
        )
        .await
        .map(drop)
    }

    async fn redfish_status(&self, redfish: &RedfishFence) -> Result<Power, String> {
        let client = self.redfish_client(redfish)?;
        let system = self.redfish_system(&client, redfish).await?;
        let body = redfish_json(&client, redfish, reqwest::Method::GET, system, None).await?;
        Ok(match body["PowerState"].as_str() {
            Some("Off") => Power::Off,
            Some("On" | "PoweringOn" | "PoweringOff" | "Paused") => Power::On,
            _ => Power::Unknown,
        })
    }
}

/// `ipmitool`의 인자(비밀번호는 넣지 않는다 — `-E`가 환경 변수에서 읽는다)
pub fn ipmi_args(ipmi: &IpmiFence, action: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut args = Vec::new();
    if ipmi.lanplus {
        args.extend(["-I".into(), "lanplus".into()]);
    }
    args.extend([
        "-H".into(),
        ipmi.address.clone(),
        "-p".into(),
        ipmi.port.to_string(),
        "-U".into(),
        ipmi.user.clone(),
    ]);
    if ipmi.password.is_some() {
        args.push("-E".into());
    }
    args.extend(["chassis".into(), "power".into(), action.into()]);
    args
}

/// `ipmitool chassis power status`의 출력(`Chassis Power is on|off`)
fn ipmi_power(out: &str) -> Power {
    let out = out.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if out.contains("chassis power is off") {
        Power::Off
    } else if out.contains("chassis power is on") {
        Power::On
    } else {
        Power::Unknown
    }
}

/// `status` 명령 출력의 첫 줄(공백을 떼고 소문자)
fn command_power(out: &str) -> Power {
    match out
        .lines()
        .next()
        .unwrap_or("")
        .trim()
        .to_ascii_lowercase()
        .as_str()
    {
        "off" => Power::Off,
        "on" => Power::On,
        _ => Power::Unknown,
    }
}

/// `/bin/sh -c <script>`의 표준 출력. 환경 변수로 끌 노드를 알린다. orbivisord의 환경은 넘기지 않는다(`PATH`와
/// `ORBIVISOR_NODE_*`만). 스크립트가 비밀을 찍을 수 있으므로 실패의 출력은 오류에 담지 않고 로그에만 남긴다.
async fn run_shell(node: &Node, script: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut command = tokio::process::Command::new("/bin/sh");
    command
        .arg("-c")
        .arg(script)
        .env_clear()
        .env(
            "PATH",
            std::env::var_os("PATH").unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_PATH.into()),
        )
        .env("ORBIVISOR_NODE_NAME", &node.name)
        .env("ORBIVISOR_NODE_ID", node.id.to_string())
        .env("ORBIVISOR_NODE_ADDRESS", host_of(&node.spec.address));
    output(command, "command").await
}

/// 명령을 돌려 표준 출력을 돌려준다. 실패하면 종료 상태가 오류이고 stderr(없으면 stdout) 앞부분은 경고 로그에만
/// 남긴다(BMC 주소나 스크립트가 찍은 비밀을 담을 수 있다). 명령은 자기 프로세스 그룹에서 돌고, 끝나기 전에 버려지면(제한 시간)
/// 그룹을 통째로 죽인다(명령이 띄운 손자까지). 끝남은 명령 자신의 종료로 보고, 출력은 그 뒤
/// [`OUTPUT_GRACE`]까지만 기다린다(출력 파이프를 쥔 백그라운드 자식을 기다리지 않는다).
async fn output(mut command: tokio::process::Command, name: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    use std::process::Stdio;

    let mut child = command
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped())
        // 제한 시간이 지나 버리면 명령도 끝낸다.
        .kill_on_drop(true)
        .process_group(0)
        .spawn()
        .map_err(|e| format!("cannot run {name}: {e}"))?;
    let mut group = GroupKill(child.id());
    let (stdout, stderr) = (Captured::default(), Captured::default());
    // 버려지면 읽기도 멈춘다.
    let mut readers = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
    if let Some(pipe) = child.stdout.take() {
        readers.spawn(stdout.clone().drain(pipe));
    }
    if let Some(pipe) = child.stderr.take() {
        readers.spawn(stderr.clone().drain(pipe));
    }
    let status = child
        .wait()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("cannot run {name}: {e}"))?;
    // 명령은 끝났다. 남은 백그라운드 자식은 그대로 둔다.
    group.0 = None;
    let _ = tokio::time::timeout(OUTPUT_GRACE, async {
        while readers.join_next().await.is_some() {}
    })
    .await;
    let stdout = stdout.text();
    if !status.success() {
        let stderr = stderr.text();
        let text = if stderr.trim().is_empty() {
            stdout.trim()
        } else {
            stderr.trim()
        };
        let text: String = text.chars().take(OUTPUT_LIMIT).collect();
        tracing::warn!(command = name, %status, output = %text, "power fencing command failed");
        return Err(format!("{name} failed ({status})"));
    }
    Ok(stdout)
}

/// 명령의 프로세스 그룹. 버려질 때 그룹이 남아 있으면(`Some`) 통째로 `SIGKILL`한다.
struct GroupKill(Option<u32>);

impl Drop for GroupKill {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(pgid) = self.0.and_then(|pid| libc::pid_t::try_from(pid).ok()) {
            // SAFETY: 메모리를 건드리지 않는 시스템 호출이다. 그룹이 이미 없으면 ESRCH로 끝난다.
            unsafe {
                libc::killpg(pgid, libc::SIGKILL);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// 명령 출력을 [`OUTPUT_CAPTURE`]까지 받아 둔다(그 뒤는 읽어 버린다).
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct Captured(Arc<Mutex<Vec<u8>>>);

impl Captured {
    async fn drain(self, mut pipe: impl tokio::io::AsyncRead + Unpin) {
        use tokio::io::AsyncReadExt;

        let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
        while let Ok(n) = pipe.read(&mut chunk).await {
            if n == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let mut buf = self.0.lock().unwrap();
            let room = OUTPUT_CAPTURE.saturating_sub(buf.len()).min(n);
            buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..room]);
        }
    }

    fn text(&self) -> String {
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.0.lock().unwrap()).into_owned()
    }
}

/// `host:port`·`[v6]:port`의 호스트
fn host_of(address: &str) -> &str {
    if let Some(rest) = address.strip_prefix('[') {
        return rest.split(']').next().unwrap_or(rest);
    }
    match address.rsplit_once(':') {
        Some((host, _)) if !host.contains(':') => host,
        _ => address,
    }
}

fn parse_url(url: &str) -> Result<reqwest::Url, String> {
    reqwest::Url::parse(url).map_err(|e| format!("invalid url: {e}"))
}

/// 경고 로그에 쓰는 URL의 `호스트[:포트]`(경로·사용자 정보는 빼고)
fn host_port(url: &reqwest::Url) -> String {
    let host = url.host_str().unwrap_or("");
    match url.port() {
        Some(port) => format!("{host}:{port}"),
        None => host.to_string(),
    }
}

/// Redfish 요청 하나(Basic 인증). 2xx가 아니면 오류. 본문이 비었거나 JSON이 아니면 null이다. 오류에는 HTTP 상태나
/// "connection failed"·"timed out"만 담고 호스트와 자세한 이유는 경고 로그에 남긴다.
async fn redfish_json(
    client: &reqwest::Client,
    redfish: &RedfishFence,
    method: reqwest::Method,
    url: reqwest::Url,
    body: Option<Value>,
) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let mut request = client
        .request(method.clone(), url.clone())
        .basic_auth(&redfish.user, redfish.password.as_deref())
        .header(reqwest::header::ACCEPT, "application/json");
    if let Some(body) = body {
        request = request.json(&body);
    }
    let host = host_port(&url);
    let failed = |e: reqwest::Error| {
        let why = if e.is_timeout() {
            "timed out"
        } else {
            "connection failed"
        };
        tracing::warn!(bmc = %host, %method, error = %crate::telemetry::chain(&e.without_url()), "redfish request failed");
        format!("{method} {why}")
    };
    let response = request.send().await.map_err(failed)?;
    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        tracing::warn!(bmc = %host, %method, %status, "redfish request refused");
        return Err(format!("{method} returned {status}"));
    }
    let bytes = response.bytes().await.map_err(failed)?;
    Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap_or(Value::Null))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn ipmi(password: Option<&str>, lanplus: bool) -> IpmiFence {
        IpmiFence {
            address: "10.0.0.9".into(),
            port: 6230,
            user: "admin".into(),
            password: password.map(Into::into),
            lanplus,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipmi_args_never_carry_the_password() {
        assert_eq!(
            ipmi_args(&ipmi(Some("s3cret"), true), "off"),
            [
                "-I", "lanplus", "-H", "10.0.0.9", "-p", "6230", "-U", "admin", "-E", "chassis",
                "power", "off"
            ]
        );
        // IPMI 1.5에 비밀번호 없음
        assert_eq!(
            ipmi_args(&ipmi(None, false), "status"),
            [
                "-H", "10.0.0.9", "-p", "6230", "-U", "admin", "chassis", "power", "status"
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_power_from_outputs() {
        assert_eq!(ipmi_power("Chassis Power is off\n"), Power::Off);
        assert_eq!(ipmi_power("Chassis Power is on\n"), Power::On);
        assert_eq!(
            ipmi_power("Error: Unable to establish IPMI v2 session"),
            Power::Unknown
        );
        assert_eq!(command_power(" OFF \nmore"), Power::Off);
        assert_eq!(command_power("on"), Power::On);
        assert_eq!(command_power("standby"), Power::Unknown);
        assert_eq!(command_power(""), Power::Unknown);
    }

    #[test]
    fn host_of_strips_the_port() {
        assert_eq!(host_of("10.0.0.1:8006"), "10.0.0.1");
        assert_eq!(host_of("node-a:8006"), "node-a");
        assert_eq!(host_of("[fd00::1]:8006"), "fd00::1");
        assert_eq!(host_of("node-a"), "node-a");
        assert_eq!(host_of("fd00::1"), "fd00::1");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! 노드 전원 끄기 펜싱 설정 `/nodes/{key}/fence`와 `fence-test`

mod common;

use std::sync::Arc;

use common::Env;
use opl_api::{FenceStatusSource, Fencer};
use opl_peer::FenceSource;
use opl_types::fence::{FenceKind, FenceMethodStatus, NodeFenceSpec, Power};
use opl_types::node::{FEATURES, Node, NodeSpec, NodeStatus};
use opl_types::resource::Resource;
use reqwest::StatusCode;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tempfile::TempDir;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// 저장소에만 있는 노드(실행기 없음). `features`가 거짓이면 옛 노드다.
async fn add_node(env: &Env, name: &str, witness: bool, features: bool) -> Uuid {
    let mut node: Node = Resource::new(
        name,
        NodeSpec {
            address: "10.0.0.7:8006".into(),
            maintenance: false,
            witness,
            roles: None,
        },
    );
    node.status = NodeStatus {
        online: false,
        features: if features {
            FEATURES.iter().map(|f| f.to_string()).collect()
        } else {
            vec![]
        },
        ..Default::default()
    };
    env.cluster.create(&node).await.unwrap();
    node.id
}

fn ipmi(address: &str, password: Option<&str>) -> Value {
    let mut m = json!({ "kind": "ipmi", "address": address, "user": "admin" });
    if let Some(p) = password {
        m["password"] = json!(p);
    }
    m
}

fn stored(env: &Env, node: Uuid) -> Option<NodeFenceSpec> {
    env.cluster
        .get::<NodeFenceSpec>(node)
        .unwrap()
        .map(|f| f.spec)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn fencing_is_set_read_and_deleted_without_showing_passwords() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let node = add_node(&env, "node2", false, true).await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    assert_eq!(
        admin.get("/nodes/node2/fence").await.0,
        StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
    );

    let body = json!({ "methods": [
        ipmi("10.0.0.9", Some("ipmi-s3cret")),
        { "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "root", "password": "rf-s3cret", "system_id": "1" },
        { "kind": "command", "off": "pdu off 3", "status": "pdu status 3" },
    ]});
    let (status, view) = admin.put("/nodes/node2/fence", body, None).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{view}");
    assert!(!view.to_string().contains("s3cret"), "{view}");
    assert_eq!(view["node"], "node2");
    assert_eq!(
        view["methods"][0],
        json!({ "kind": "ipmi", "address": "10.0.0.9", "port": 623, "user": "admin", "lanplus": true, "has_password": true })
    );
    assert_eq!(view["methods"][1]["has_password"], true);
    assert_eq!(view["methods"][1]["system_id"], "1");
    assert_eq!(view["methods"][2]["off"], "pdu off 3");
    let (status, got) = admin.get(&format!("/nodes/{node}/fence")).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK);
    assert_eq!(got, view);
    // 리소스 id는 노드 id다.
    let spec = stored(&env, node).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(spec.methods.len(), 3);

    // 비밀번호를 빼면 저장된 값을 둔다(순서를 바꿔도 같은 BMC면). 빈 글이면 지운다.
    let (status, view) = admin
        .put(
            "/nodes/node2/fence",
            json!({ "methods": [
                { "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "root", "system_id": "1" },
                ipmi("10.0.0.9", Some("")),
            ]}),
            None,
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{view}");
    assert_eq!(view["methods"][0]["has_password"], true);
    assert_eq!(view["methods"][1]["has_password"], false);
    let spec = serde_json::to_value(stored(&env, node).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(spec["methods"][0]["password"], "rf-s3cret");
    assert!(spec["methods"][1].get("password").is_none(), "{spec}");

    // 저장된 비밀번호를 다른 BMC로 보내지 않는다: 주소나 사용자를 바꾸면 다시 줘야 한다.
    for changed in [
        json!({ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://other", "user": "root", "system_id": "1" }),
        json!({ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "other", "system_id": "1" }),
        json!({ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "root", "insecure": true }),
    ] {
        let (status, body) = admin
            .put("/nodes/node2/fence", json!({ "methods": [changed] }), None)
            .await;
        assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{body}");
        assert!(
            body["message"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap()
                .contains("password must be given again when the address, port or user changes (redfish: url, user, ca_pem or insecure)"),
            "{body}"
        );
    }
    // 형식이 틀리면 400
    for bad in [
        json!({ "methods": [] }),
        json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "redfish", "url": "bmc", "user": "u" }] }),
        // 자격 증명이 든 URL
        json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://root:pw@bmc", "user": "u" }] }),
        // 경로·쿼리가 든 URL, 경로를 바꾸는 system_id
        json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc/redfish/v1", "user": "u" }] }),
        json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc?a=1", "user": "u" }] }),
        json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "u", "system_id": ".." }] }),
        json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "u", "system_id": "1?x" }] }),
        json!({ "methods": [ipmi("10.0.0.9", None)], "extra": 1 }),
    ] {
        let (status, body) = admin.put("/nodes/node2/fence", bad.clone(), None).await;
        assert!(
            status == StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST || status == StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            "{bad}: {status} {body}"
        );
    }

    assert_eq!(
        admin.delete("/nodes/node2/fence").await.0,
        StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
    );
    assert_eq!(stored(&env, node), None);
    assert_eq!(
        admin.delete("/nodes/node2/fence").await.0,
        StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn only_admins_handle_fencing() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    add_node(&env, "node2", false, true).await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let body = json!({ "methods": [ipmi("10.0.0.9", Some("pw"))] });
    assert_eq!(
        admin.put("/nodes/node2/fence", body.clone(), None).await.0,
        StatusCode::OK
    );
    for role in ["operator", "viewer"] {
        let user = env.user(role, role).await;
        assert_eq!(
            user.get("/nodes/node2/fence").await.0,
            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            "{role}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            user.put("/nodes/node2/fence", body.clone(), None).await.0,
            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            "{role}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            user.delete("/nodes/node2/fence").await.0,
            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            "{role}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            user.post("/nodes/node2/fence-test", json!({})).await.0,
            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
            "{role}"
        );
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn witnesses_and_old_clusters_are_refused() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    add_node(&env, "witness", true, true).await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let body = json!({ "methods": [ipmi("10.0.0.9", Some("pw"))] });
    let (status, err) = admin.put("/nodes/witness/fence", body.clone(), None).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{err}");
    assert!(
        err["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("witness"),
        "{err}"
    );

    // `fast-ha`를 모르는 노드가 있으면 쓰지 않는다.
    add_node(&env, "old", false, false).await;
    let (status, err) = admin.put("/nodes/node1/fence", body.clone(), None).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CONFLICT, "{err}");
    assert_eq!(err["code"], "cluster_upgrading");
    assert!(err["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("old"), "{err}");
    assert_eq!(stored(&env, env.node), None);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn removing_a_node_removes_its_fencing() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let node = add_node(&env, "node2", false, true).await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let body = json!({ "methods": [ipmi("10.0.0.9", Some("pw"))] });
    assert_eq!(
        admin.put("/nodes/node2/fence", body, None).await.0,
        StatusCode::OK
    );
    assert!(stored(&env, node).is_some());
    let (status, body) = admin.delete("/nodes/node2").await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NO_CONTENT, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(stored(&env, node), None);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn fence_test_reads_the_power_without_touching_it() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    add_node(&env, "node2", false, true).await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let d = dir.path().display();
    let command = json!({
        "kind": "command",
        // 시험은 끄기를 부르지 않는다.
        "off": format!("touch {d}/off-called"),
        "status": format!("if [ -f {d}/off-mark ]; then echo off; else echo on; fi; echo \"$ORBIVISOR_NODE_NAME\" > {d}/asked"),
    });
    let broken =
        json!({ "kind": "command", "off": "true", "status": "echo no BMC here >&2; exit 2" });
    assert_eq!(
        admin
            .put(
                "/nodes/node2/fence",
                json!({ "methods": [command, broken] }),
                None
            )
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::OK
    );

    // 다른 노드는 이 API 노드가 스스로 읽는다.
    let (status, result) = admin.post("/nodes/node2/fence-test", json!({})).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{result}");
    assert_eq!(result["checked_by"], "node1");
    assert_eq!(
        result["methods"][0],
        json!({ "kind": "command", "power": "on" })
    );
    // 명령의 출력은 비밀을 담을 수 있어 답에 담지 않는다(종료 상태만, 출력은 로그에).
    assert_eq!(
        result["methods"][1],
        json!({ "kind": "command", "power": "unknown", "error": "command failed (exit status: 2)" })
    );
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join("asked")).unwrap(),
        "node2\n"
    );
    std::fs::write(dir.path().join("off-mark"), "").unwrap();
    let (_, result) = admin.post("/nodes/node2/fence-test", json!({})).await;
    assert_eq!(result["methods"][0]["power"], "off");
    assert!(!dir.path().join("off-called").exists());

    // 펜싱이 없으면 404
    assert_eq!(
        admin.post("/nodes/node1/fence-test", json!({})).await.0,
        StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
    );
    // 이 노드 자신은 이웃에게 부탁한다. 온라인 이웃이 없으면 409.
    assert_eq!(
        admin
            .put(
                "/nodes/node1/fence",
                json!({ "methods": [ipmi("10.0.0.9", Some("pw"))] }),
                None
            )
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::OK
    );
    let (status, err) = admin.post("/nodes/node1/fence-test", json!({})).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CONFLICT, "{err}");
    assert_eq!(err["code"], "no_fence_checker");
}

/// 이웃 확인 RPC(`FenceStatus`)의 받는 쪽: 이 노드 저장소의 `NodeFence`로 읽는다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn the_fence_status_source_reads_with_the_stored_methods() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let node = add_node(&env, "node2", false, true).await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let source = FenceStatusSource {
        cluster: env.cluster.clone(),
        fence: Arc::new(Fencer::default()),
    };
    let err = source.status(node).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(err.contains("has no power fencing"), "{err}");
    let err = source.status(Uuid::nil()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(err.contains("not found"), "{err}");
    assert_eq!(
        admin
            .put(
                "/nodes/node2/fence",
                json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "command", "off": "true", "status": "echo off" }] }),
                None
            )
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::OK
    );
    assert_eq!(
        source.status(node).await.unwrap(),
        [FenceMethodStatus {
            kind: FenceKind::Command,
            power: Power::Off,
            error: None,
        }]
    );
}
```

```rust
//! 전원 끄기 펜싱 실행기([`Fencer`])와 [`power_off`]: 가짜 `ipmitool` 셸 스크립트, 프로세스 안의 가짜 Redfish
//! 서버(127.0.0.1), 명령 방법.

use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;

use axum::extract::{Path as UrlPath, State};
use axum::http::{HeaderMap, StatusCode};
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use axum::routing::{get, post};
use base64::Engine;
use opl_api::power_fence::{Fencer, PowerFence, PowerOff, power_off, power_off_within};
use opl_types::fence::{
    CommandFence, FenceKind, FenceMethod, IpmiFence, NodeFenceSpec, Power, RedfishFence,
};
use opl_types::node::{Node, NodeSpec};
use opl_types::resource::Resource;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tempfile::TempDir;
use uuid::Uuid;

fn node() -> Node {
    let mut n = Resource::new(
        "node-b",
        NodeSpec {
            address: "10.1.2.3:8006".into(),
            maintenance: false,
            witness: false,
            roles: None,
        },
    );
    n.id = Uuid::from_u128(0xb);
    n
}

/// 가짜 `ipmitool`: 부를 때마다 `<인자> pw=<IPMI_PASSWORD>`를 `calls`에 더한다. `fail`이 있으면 실패하고,
/// `power off`면 `stuck`이 없을 때 `power`를 `off`로 바꾼다. `power status`는 `Chassis Power is <power>`다.
const IPMITOOL: &str = r#"#!/bin/sh
d=$(dirname "$0")
echo "$* pw=${IPMI_PASSWORD-unset}" >> "$d/calls"
if [ -f "$d/fail" ]; then
    echo "Error: Unable to establish IPMI v2 / RMCP+ session ($*)" >&2
    exit 1
fi
case "$*" in
*"power off") [ -f "$d/stuck" ] || echo off > "$d/power"; echo "Chassis Power Control: Down/Off" ;;
*"power status") echo "Chassis Power is $(cat "$d/power")" ;;
esac
"#;

struct FakeIpmi {
    dir: TempDir,
}

impl FakeIpmi {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("ipmitool");
        std::fs::write(&path, IPMITOOL).unwrap();
        let mut perms = std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().permissions();
        std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt::set_mode(&mut perms, 0o755);
        std::fs::set_permissions(&path, perms).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.path().join("power"), "on\n").unwrap();
        Self { dir }
    }

    fn fencer(&self) -> Fencer {
        Fencer {
            ipmitool: self.dir.path().join("ipmitool"),
            timeout: Duration::from_secs(5),
        }
    }

    fn touch(&self, name: &str) {
        std::fs::write(self.dir.path().join(name), "").unwrap();
    }

    fn calls(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        read_lines(&self.dir.path().join("calls"))
    }
}

fn read_lines(path: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(path)
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .lines()
        .map(str::to_string)
        .collect()
}

fn ipmi(password: Option<&str>) -> FenceMethod {
    FenceMethod::Ipmi(IpmiFence {
        address: "10.9.9.9".into(),
        port: 623,
        user: "admin".into(),
        password: password.map(Into::into),
        lanplus: true,
    })
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn ipmi_turns_the_node_off_with_the_password_in_the_environment() {
    let fake = FakeIpmi::new();
    let fencer = fake.fencer();
    let m = ipmi(Some("s3cret"));
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::On));
    fencer.off(&node(), &m).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::Off));
    let base = "-I lanplus -H 10.9.9.9 -p 623 -U admin -E chassis power";
    assert_eq!(
        fake.calls(),
        [
            format!("{base} status pw=s3cret"),
            format!("{base} off pw=s3cret"),
            format!("{base} status pw=s3cret"),
        ]
    );

    // 비밀번호가 없으면 `-E`도 환경 변수도 없다.
    std::fs::remove_file(fake.dir.path().join("calls")).unwrap();
    fencer.status(&node(), &ipmi(None)).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fake.calls(),
        ["-I lanplus -H 10.9.9.9 -p 623 -U admin chassis power status pw=unset"]
    );

    // 0이 아닌 종료는 실패이고 종료 상태만 담는다(stderr의 BMC 주소는 모든 뷰어가 읽는 오류에 넣지 않는다).
    fake.touch("fail");
    let err = fencer.off(&node(), &m).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err, "ipmitool failed (exit status: 1)");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn power_off_confirms_and_gives_up_when_the_power_stays_on() {
    let fake = FakeIpmi::new();
    let fencer = fake.fencer();
    let spec = NodeFenceSpec {
        methods: vec![ipmi(Some("pw"))],
    };
    assert_eq!(
        power_off(&fencer, &node(), &spec).await,
        PowerOff::Off {
            method: FenceKind::Ipmi
        }
    );

    // 끄기는 성공해도 전원이 계속 켜져 있으면 확인 제한 시간 뒤 실패다.
    std::fs::write(fake.dir.path().join("power"), "on\n").unwrap();
    fake.touch("stuck");
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let PowerOff::Failed(errors) =
        power_off_within(&fencer, &node(), &spec, Duration::from_secs(2)).await
    else {
        panic!("the power never went off");
    };
    assert!(started.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(1), "{errors:?}");
    assert_eq!(errors.len(), 1, "{errors:?}");
    assert!(
        errors[0].starts_with("ipmi: power off not confirmed"),
        "{errors:?}"
    );
    assert!(errors[0].contains("power is on"), "{errors:?}");
}

/// 끌 때 `off-mark`를 만들고 받은 환경 변수를 `env`에 적는 명령 방법
fn command(dir: &Path) -> FenceMethod {
    let d = dir.display();
    FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
        off: format!(
            "echo \"$ORBIVISOR_NODE_NAME $ORBIVISOR_NODE_ID $ORBIVISOR_NODE_ADDRESS\" > {d}/env; touch {d}/off-mark"
        ),
        status: format!("if [ -f {d}/off-mark ]; then echo OFF; else echo ' on'; fi"),
    })
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn command_gets_the_node_in_its_environment() {
    let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let fencer = Fencer::default();
    let m = command(dir.path());
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::On));
    fencer.off(&node(), &m).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::Off));
    assert_eq!(
        read_lines(&dir.path().join("env")),
        [format!("node-b {} 10.1.2.3", Uuid::from_u128(0xb))]
    );

    // 첫 줄이 `on`·`off`가 아니면 모름, 0이 아닌 종료는 실패다.
    let garbage = FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
        off: "exit 3".into(),
        status: "echo standby; echo off".into(),
    });
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &garbage).await, Ok(Power::Unknown));
    let err = fencer.off(&node(), &garbage).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(err.contains("exit status: 3"), "{err}");
    // 명령의 출력은 비밀을 담을 수 있어 오류(Task·`fence_check`로 간다)에 담지 않는다.
    let err = fencer
        .off(
            &node(),
            &FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
                off: "echo nope >&2; false".into(),
                status: "echo on".into(),
            }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err, "command failed (exit status: 1)");

    // 제한 시간을 넘긴 명령은 버린다.
    let slow = Fencer {
        timeout: Duration::from_millis(300),
        ..Fencer::default()
    };
    let hang = FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
        off: "sleep 10".into(),
        status: "sleep 10".into(),
    });
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let err = slow.status(&node(), &hang).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(err.starts_with("timed out"), "{err}");
    assert!(started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5));
}

/// 명령에는 orbivisord의 환경을 넘기지 않는다: `PATH`와 `ORBIVISOR_NODE_*`(그리고 셸이 스스로 두는 것)만 있다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_command_gets_only_path_and_the_node_variables() {
    let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let d = dir.path().display();
    let m = FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
        off: "true".into(),
        status: format!("env > {d}/env; echo on"),
    });
    assert_eq!(Fencer::default().status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::On));
    let names: Vec<String> = read_lines(&dir.path().join("env"))
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|l| l.split_once('=').map(|(k, _)| k.to_string()))
        .collect();
    assert!(names.iter().any(|n| n == "PATH"), "{names:?}");
    assert!(
        names.iter().any(|n| n == "ORBIVISOR_NODE_NAME"),
        "{names:?}"
    );
    // 셸이 두는 것 말고는 없다(시험 프로세스의 `HOME`·`CARGO_*` 등이 새지 않는다).
    let allowed = [
        "PATH",
        "ORBIVISOR_NODE_NAME",
        "ORBIVISOR_NODE_ID",
        "ORBIVISOR_NODE_ADDRESS",
        "PWD",
        "OLDPWD",
        "SHLVL",
        "_",
    ];
    assert!(
        names.iter().all(|n| allowed.contains(&n.as_str())),
        "{names:?}"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn power_off_falls_back_to_the_next_method() {
    let fake = FakeIpmi::new();
    fake.touch("fail");
    let fencer = fake.fencer();
    let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let spec = NodeFenceSpec {
        methods: vec![ipmi(Some("pw")), command(dir.path())],
    };
    assert_eq!(
        power_off(&fencer, &node(), &spec).await,
        PowerOff::Off {
            method: FenceKind::Command
        }
    );
    assert!(dir.path().join("off-mark").exists());

    // 모두 실패하면 방법마다의 이유
    let spec = NodeFenceSpec {
        methods: vec![
            ipmi(Some("pw")),
            FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
                off: "echo broken >&2; exit 1".into(),
                status: "echo on".into(),
            }),
        ],
    };
    let PowerOff::Failed(errors) = power_off(&fencer, &node(), &spec).await else {
        panic!("a method succeeded");
    };
    assert_eq!(errors.len(), 2, "{errors:?}");
    assert!(errors[0].starts_with("ipmi: "), "{errors:?}");
    assert!(errors[1].starts_with("command: "), "{errors:?}");
    assert!(!errors[1].contains("broken"), "{errors:?}");
}

/// 명령이 끝나면 출력 파이프를 쥔 채 남은 백그라운드 자식을 기다리지 않는다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_command_leaving_a_background_child_ends_with_the_command() {
    let fencer = Fencer {
        timeout: Duration::from_secs(4),
        ..Fencer::default()
    };
    let m = FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
        off: "true".into(),
        status: "sleep 6 & echo on".into(),
    });
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::On));

    );

/// 제한 시간을 넘긴 명령은 그 명령이 띄운 손자 프로세스까지 끝낸다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_timed_out_command_kills_its_grandchildren() {
    let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let pid_file = dir.path().join("pid");
    let fencer = Fencer {
        timeout: Duration::from_millis(500),
        ..Fencer::default()
    };
    let m = FenceMethod::Command(CommandFence {
        off: format!("sleep 30 & echo $! > {}; wait", pid_file.display()),
        status: "echo on".into(),
    });
    let err = fencer.off(&node(), &m).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(err.starts_with("timed out"), "{err}");
    let pid = std::fs::read_to_string(&pid_file).unwrap();
    let pid = pid.trim();
    let alive = || {
        std::process::Command::new("kill")
            .args(["-0", pid])
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .status()
            .unwrap()
            .success()
    };
    let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    while alive() {
        assert!(
            std::time::Instant::now() < deadline,
            "the grandchild {pid} is still running"
        );
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
    }
}

/// 프로세스 안의 가짜 Redfish BMC. `admin:pw`만 받고(아니면 401) `Reset`의 본문을 적는다.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct Bmc {
    systems: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
    off: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    resets: Arc<Mutex<Vec<(String, Value)>>>,
    slow: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    /// `Reset`에 409로 답하고 끄지 않는다(이미 꺼진 노드에 409를 주는 BMC).
    refuse: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    /// `Systems`의 멤버가 다른 출처(포트)를 가리킨다.
    foreign: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

impl Bmc {
    async fn start(systems: usize) -> (Bmc, String) {
        let bmc = Bmc::default();
        bmc.systems.store(systems, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let app = axum::Router::new()
            .route("/redfish/v1/Systems", get(list))
            .route("/redfish/v1/Systems/{id}", get(system))
            .route(
                "/redfish/v1/Systems/{id}/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset",
                post(reset),
            )
            .with_state(bmc.clone());
        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let url = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _ = axum::serve(listener, app).await;
        });
        (bmc, url)
    }

    async fn check(&self, headers: &HeaderMap) -> Result<(), StatusCode> {
        if self.slow.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
        }
        let expected = format!(
            "Basic {}",
            base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode("admin:pw")
        );
        if headers.get("authorization").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()) != Some(&expected) {
            return Err(StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

async fn list(State(bmc): State<Bmc>, headers: HeaderMap) -> Response {
    if let Err(s) = bmc.check(&headers).await {
        return s.into_response();
    }
    let prefix = if bmc.foreign.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        "http://127.0.0.1:9"
    } else {
        ""
    };
    let members: Vec<Value> = (1..=bmc.systems.load(Ordering::SeqCst))
        .map(|i| json!({ "@odata.id": format!("{prefix}/redfish/v1/Systems/{i}") }))
        .collect();
    axum::Json(json!({ "Members": members })).into_response()
}

async fn system(
    State(bmc): State<Bmc>,
    UrlPath(_id): UrlPath<String>,
    headers: HeaderMap,
) -> Response {
    if let Err(s) = bmc.check(&headers).await {
        return s.into_response();
    }
    let state = if bmc.off.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        "Off"
    } else {
        "On"
    };
    axum::Json(json!({ "PowerState": state })).into_response()
}

async fn reset(
    State(bmc): State<Bmc>,
    UrlPath(id): UrlPath<String>,
    headers: HeaderMap,
    axum::Json(body): axum::Json<Value>,
) -> Response {
    if let Err(s) = bmc.check(&headers).await {
        return s.into_response();
    }
    if bmc.refuse.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return StatusCode::CONFLICT.into_response();
    }
    bmc.resets.lock().unwrap().push((id, body));
    bmc.off.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    StatusCode::NO_CONTENT.into_response()
}

fn redfish(url: &str, password: &str, system_id: Option<&str>) -> FenceMethod {
    FenceMethod::Redfish(RedfishFence {
        url: format!("{url}/"),
        user: "admin".into(),
        password: Some(password.into()),
        system_id: system_id.map(Into::into),
        ca_pem: None,
        insecure: false,
    })
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn redfish_finds_the_only_system_resets_it_and_reads_the_power() {
    let (bmc, url) = Bmc::start(1).await;
    let fencer = Fencer::default();
    let m = redfish(&url, "pw", None);
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::On));
    let spec = NodeFenceSpec {
        methods: vec![m.clone()],
    };
    assert_eq!(
        power_off(&fencer, &node(), &spec).await,
        PowerOff::Off {
            method: FenceKind::Redfish
        }
    );
    assert_eq!(
        *bmc.resets.lock().unwrap(),
        [("1".to_string(), json!({ "ResetType": "ForceOff" }))]
    );
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node(), &m).await, Ok(Power::Off));

    // 틀린 비밀번호는 401이다. 오류에는 HTTP 상태만 담는다(BMC 주소 없이).
    let err = fencer
        .status(&node(), &redfish(&url, "wrong", None))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err, "GET returned 401 Unauthorized");
}

/// 닿지 않는 BMC는 "connection failed"만 남긴다(주소는 경고 로그에만).
#[tokio::test]
async fn an_unreachable_redfish_fails_without_its_address() {
    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let url = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
    drop(listener);
    let err = Fencer::default()
        .status(&node(), &redfish(&url, "pw", Some("1")))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err, "GET connection failed");
}

/// 끄기 요청이 실패해도 전원이 이미 꺼져 있으면 그 방법으로 꺼진 것이다. 켜져 있으면 끄기의 오류로 실패한다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_refused_reset_of_a_node_that_is_already_off_counts_as_off() {
    let (bmc, url) = Bmc::start(1).await;
    bmc.refuse.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let fencer = Fencer::default();
    let spec = NodeFenceSpec {
        methods: vec![redfish(&url, "pw", Some("1"))],
    };
    let PowerOff::Failed(errors) =
        power_off_within(&fencer, &node(), &spec, Duration::from_secs(1)).await
    else {
        panic!("the power was on");
    };
    assert_eq!(errors, ["redfish: POST returned 409 Conflict"]);
    bmc.off.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    assert_eq!(
        power_off(&fencer, &node(), &spec).await,
        PowerOff::Off {
            method: FenceKind::Redfish
        }
    );
    assert!(bmc.resets.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
}

/// `Systems`의 멤버가 `url`과 다른 출처면 따라가지 않는다(Basic 인증을 다른 곳으로 보내지 않게).
#[tokio::test]
async fn redfish_does_not_follow_a_system_on_another_host() {
    let (bmc, url) = Bmc::start(1).await;
    bmc.foreign.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let err = Fencer::default()
        .off(&node(), &redfish(&url, "pw", None))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err, "the BMC lists a system on another host");
    assert!(bmc.resets.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn redfish_needs_a_system_id_when_there_are_several_systems() {
    let (bmc, url) = Bmc::start(2).await;
    let fencer = Fencer::default();
    let err = fencer
        .off(&node(), &redfish(&url, "pw", None))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err, "the BMC lists 2 systems; set system_id");
    fencer
        .off(&node(), &redfish(&url, "pw", Some("2")))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        *bmc.resets.lock().unwrap(),
        [("2".to_string(), json!({ "ResetType": "ForceOff" }))]
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_slow_redfish_times_out() {
    let (bmc, url) = Bmc::start(1).await;
    bmc.slow.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let fencer = Fencer {
        timeout: Duration::from_millis(300),
        ..Fencer::default()
    };
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let err = fencer
        .status(&node(), &redfish(&url, "pw", Some("1")))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(3), "{err}");
    assert!(
        err.contains("timed out") || err.contains("timeout"),
        "{err}"
    );
}
```

```rust
//! Redfish 요청은 프록시 환경 변수(`HTTP_PROXY` 등)를 따르지 않는다. 환경 변수는 프로세스 전역이므로 다른 시험과
//! 나눈 시험 바이너리에서 본다.

use std::time::Duration;

use axum::routing::get;
use opl_api::power_fence::{Fencer, PowerFence};
use opl_types::fence::{FenceMethod, Power, RedfishFence};
use opl_types::node::{Node, NodeSpec};
use opl_types::resource::Resource;
use serde_json::json;

#[tokio::test]
async fn redfish_ignores_proxy_environment_variables() {
    // 닿지 않는 프록시. 따르면 연결이 거절된다.
    for var in [
        "HTTP_PROXY",
        "http_proxy",
        "HTTPS_PROXY",
        "https_proxy",
        "ALL_PROXY",
        "all_proxy",
    ] {
        // SAFETY: 이 시험 바이너리의 유일한 시험이고, 환경을 읽는 다른 스레드를 띄우기 전이다.
        unsafe { std::env::set_var(var, "http://127.0.0.1:9") };
    }
    for var in ["NO_PROXY", "no_proxy"] {
        // SAFETY: 위와 같다.
        unsafe { std::env::remove_var(var) };
    }
    let app = axum::Router::new().route(
        "/redfish/v1/Systems/1",
        get(|| async { axum::Json(json!({ "PowerState": "Off" })) }),
    );
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let url = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let _ = axum::serve(listener, app).await;
    });
    let node: Node = Resource::new(
        "node-b",
        NodeSpec {
            address: "10.1.2.3:8006".into(),
            maintenance: false,
            witness: false,
            roles: None,
        },
    );
    let fencer = Fencer {
        timeout: Duration::from_secs(5),
        ..Fencer::default()
    };
    let method = FenceMethod::Redfish(RedfishFence {
        url,
        user: "admin".into(),
        password: Some("pw".into()),
        system_id: Some("1".into()),
        ca_pem: None,
        insecure: false,
    });
    assert_eq!(fencer.status(&node, &method).await, Ok(Power::Off));
}
```

```rust
impl Peers {
    /// 노드 `via`(첫 링크 `addr`)에게 노드 `node`의 전원을 `node`의 펜싱 방법으로 읽어 달라고 한다. `via`가 이
    /// RPC를 모르면(옛 노드) None이다. `via`가 `node`나 그 `NodeFence`를 모르면 `failed_precondition`이다.
    pub async fn fence_status(
        &self,
        via: NodeId,
        addr: &str,
        node: Uuid,
        timeout: Duration,
    ) -> Result<Option<Vec<FenceMethodStatus>>, Status> {
        let reply = self
            .send_bulk(addr, |mut client| {
                let mut req = Request::new(FenceStatusRequest { node });
                req.set_timeout(timeout);
                addressed(&mut req, Some(via));
                async move { within(timeout, client.fence_status(req)).await }
            })
            .await;
        match reply {
            Ok(reply) => Ok(Some(reply.into_inner().methods)),
            Err(s) if s.code() == Code::Unimplemented => Ok(None),
            Err(s) => Err(s),
        }
    }
}

/// `fut`을 `timeout`까지만 기다린다. gRPC 제한 시간은 요청을 보낸 뒤부터 재고 tonic의 연결 제한 시간은 TCP
```

`crates/opl-peer/src/fence.rs`를 만든다:

```rust
//! 전원 끄기 펜싱 확인의 노드 사이 RPC(`FenceStatus`): 한 노드가 이웃에게 자기 BMC(펜싱 방법)로 자기 전원을
//! 읽어 달라고 한다. 리더가 그 노드를 끌 수 있는지 미리 알려고 쓴다. 읽는 쪽 처리는 opld가 [`FenceSource`]로
//! 넣는다.

use async_trait::async_trait;
use opl_types::fence::FenceMethodStatus;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use uuid::Uuid;

/// 전원을 읽을 노드
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct FenceStatusRequest {
    pub node: Uuid,
}

/// 그 노드의 `NodeFence` 방법마다의 결과(방법 순서)
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct FenceStatusReply {
    pub methods: Vec<FenceMethodStatus>,
}

/// 노드의 전원을 그 노드의 펜싱 방법으로 읽는 처리
#[async_trait]
pub trait FenceSource: Send + Sync {
    /// 방법마다 전원을 읽는다. 노드나 그 `NodeFence`가 없으면 오류다(`failed_precondition`).
    async fn status(&self, node: Uuid) -> Result<Vec<FenceMethodStatus>, String>;
}
```

```rust
    async fn fence_status(
        &self,
        req: Request<FenceStatusRequest>,
    ) -> Result<Response<FenceStatusReply>, Status> {
        self.authorize(&req)?;
        let source = self
            .fence
            .clone()
            .ok_or_else(|| Status::unimplemented("this node does not check power fencing"))?;
        let node = req.into_inner().node;
        let methods = self
            .offload(async move { source.status(node).await })
            .await?
            .map_err(Status::failed_precondition)?;
        Ok(Response::new(FenceStatusReply { methods }))
    }

    type UefiVarsStream = ReceiverStream<Result<UefiVarsChunk, Status>>;
```
