`web/src/nodes/NodeFenceDialog.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
import { type RefObject, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { ApiError, api, call } from "@/api/client";
import type { components } from "@/api/schema";
import type { Node } from "@/api/types";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { focusBack } from "@/components/focusBack";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { codeMessage, errorMessage } from "@/i18n/errors";
import {
  emptyRow,
  type FenceKind,
  type FenceRow,
  fenceErrors,
  fromView,
  MAX_FENCE_METHODS,
  toMethod,
} from "@/nodes/fence";
import { moveRule } from "@/security-groups/rules";

type FenceView = components["schemas"]["NodeFenceView"];
type FenceTest = components["schemas"]["FenceTestResult"];

const KINDS: FenceKind[] = ["ipmi", "redfish", "command"];

/** 펜싱 대화상자의 오류 문구. `nodes.fence.errors.<code>`를 먼저 찾는다. */
function fenceError(t: Parameters<typeof errorMessage>[0], err: unknown): string {
  return err instanceof ApiError
    ? codeMessage(t, err.code, err.message, "nodes.fence.errors")
    : errorMessage(t, err);
}

/**
 * 노드의 전원 끄기 펜싱(admin). 방법을 순서대로 고치고 저장하며, 저장된 설정으로 전원을 읽어 본다(끄지 않는다).
 * 연 쪽은 열 때만 그린다.
 */
export function NodeFenceDialog({
  node,
  onClose,
  returnFocus,
}: {
  node: Node;
  onClose(): void;
  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const key = ["node-fence", node.id];
  // 설정이 없으면 404이고 빈 목록으로 시작한다.
  const saved = useQuery({
    queryKey: key,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<FenceView | null> => {
      try {
        return await call(api.GET("/nodes/{key}/fence", { params: { path: { key: node.id } } }));
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404) {
          return null;
        }
        throw err;
      }
    },
  });
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState<FenceRow[] | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [test, setTest] = useState<FenceTest | null>(null);

  const view = saved.data ?? null;
  const rows = edited ?? (view ? view.methods.map(fromView) : []);
  const change = (next: FenceRow[]) => {
    setEdited(next);
    setTest(null);
  };
  const setRow = (i: number, patch: Partial<FenceRow>) =>
    change(rows.map((r, j) => (j === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)));

  async function run(action: () => Promise<void>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await action();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(fenceError(t, err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function save(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const found = fenceErrors(rows);
    setErrors(found);
    if (Object.keys(found).length > 0) {
      return;
    }
    await run(async () => {
      const updated = await call(
        api.PUT("/nodes/{key}/fence", {
          params: {
            path: { key: node.id },
            header: view ? { "If-Match": view.revision } : {},
          },
          body: { methods: rows.map(toMethod) },
        }),
      );
      queryClient.setQueryData(key, updated);
      setEdited(null);
      toast.success(t("nodes.fence.saved", { name: node.name }));
    });
  }

  async function remove() {
    await run(async () => {
      await call(
        api.DELETE("/nodes/{key}/fence", {
          params: { path: { key: node.id }, header: { "If-Match": view!.revision } },
        }),
      );
      queryClient.setQueryData(key, null);
      setEdited(null);
      toast.success(t("nodes.fence.removed", { name: node.name }));
    });
  }

  async function check() {
    await run(async () => {
      setTest(
        await call(api.POST("/nodes/{key}/fence-test", { params: { path: { key: node.id } } })),
      );
    });
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(open) => !open && !busy && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-2xl" onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => focusBack(e, returnFocus)}>
        <form noValidate onSubmit={(e) => void save(e)} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("nodes.fence.title", { name: node.name })}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{t("nodes.fence.description")}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          {saved.isPending || saved.isError ? (
            <ListPending error={saved.error} />
          ) : (
            <fieldset disabled={busy} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
              {rows.length === 0 && (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.fence.none")}</p>
              )}
              <ol className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                {rows.map((row, i) => (
                  <MethodRow
                    key={i}
                    row={row}
                    i={i}
                    last={i === rows.length - 1}
                    errors={errors}
                    onChange={(patch) => setRow(i, patch)}
                    onKind={(kind) => change(rows.map((r, j) => (j === i ? emptyRow(kind) : r)))}
                    onMove={(by) => change(moveRule(rows, i, by))}
                    onRemove={() => change(rows.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}
                  />
                ))}
              </ol>
              {rows.length < MAX_FENCE_METHODS && (
                <div>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => change([...rows, emptyRow("ipmi")])}
                  >
                    <Plus />
                    {t("nodes.fence.add")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.fence.note")}</p>
            </fieldset>
          )}
          {test && <TestResult test={test} />}
          <DialogFooter>
            {view && (
              <>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="destructive"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void remove()}
                >
                  {t("nodes.fence.remove")}
                </Button>
                {/* 저장된 설정으로 읽는다. */}
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  disabled={busy || edited !== null}
                  onClick={() => void check()}
                >
                  {t("nodes.fence.test")}
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose}>
              {t("common.cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || edited === null || rows.length === 0}>
              {t("common.save")}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/** 방법 한 줄: 종류와 그 종류의 칸, 순서 바꾸기·빼기 */
function MethodRow({
  row,
  i,
  last,
  errors,
  onChange,
  onKind,
  onMove,
  onRemove,
}: {
  row: FenceRow;
  i: number;
  last: boolean;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
  onChange(patch: Partial<FenceRow>): void;
  onKind(kind: FenceKind): void;
  onMove(by: -1 | 1): void;
  onRemove(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const n = { n: i + 1 };
  const id = (field: string) => `fence-${i}-${field}`;
  const text = (field: keyof FenceRow & string, label: string, hint?: string) => (
    <Field id={id(field)} label={label} error={errors[`${i}.${field}`]} hint={hint}>
      {(a11y) => (
        <Input
          id={id(field)}
          autoComplete="off"
          value={row[field] as string}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ [field]: e.target.value })}
          {...a11y}
        />
      )}
    </Field>
  );
  const password = (
    <>
      <Field
        id={id("password")}
        label={t("nodes.fence.password")}
        hint={row.hasPassword ? t("nodes.fence.passwordSaved") : undefined}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <Input
            id={id("password")}
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={row.password}
            disabled={row.clearPassword}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ password: e.target.value })}
            {...a11y}
          />
        )}
      </Field>
      {row.hasPassword && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:col-span-2">
          <Checkbox
            id={id("clearPassword")}
            checked={row.clearPassword}
            onCheckedChange={(v) => onChange({ clearPassword: v === true, password: "" })}
          />
          <Label htmlFor={id("clearPassword")}>{t("nodes.fence.clearPassword")}</Label>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
  return (
    <li
      aria-label={t("nodes.fence.method", n)}
      className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3"
    >
      <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
        <Field id={id("kind")} label={t("nodes.fence.kind", n)}>
          <NativeSelect
            id={id("kind")}
            value={row.kind}
            onChange={(e) => onKind(e.target.value as FenceKind)}
          >
            {KINDS.map((k) => (
              <NativeSelectOption key={k} value={k}>
                {t(`nodes.fence.kinds.${k}`)}
              </NativeSelectOption>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>
        <div className="ml-auto flex">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon-sm"
            aria-label={t("nodes.fence.moveUp", n)}
            disabled={i === 0}
            onClick={() => onMove(-1)}
          >
            <ArrowUp />
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon-sm"
            aria-label={t("nodes.fence.moveDown", n)}
            disabled={last}
            onClick={() => onMove(1)}
          >
            <ArrowDown />
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon-sm"
            aria-label={t("nodes.fence.removeMethod", n)}
            onClick={onRemove}
          >
            <X />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {row.kind === "ipmi" && (
          <>
            {text("address", t("nodes.fence.address"))}
            {text("port", t("nodes.fence.port"))}
            {text("user", t("nodes.fence.user"))}
            {password}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox
                id={id("lanplus")}
                checked={row.lanplus}
                onCheckedChange={(v) => onChange({ lanplus: v === true })}
              />
              <Label htmlFor={id("lanplus")}>{t("nodes.fence.lanplus")}</Label>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {row.kind === "redfish" && (
          <>
            {text("address", t("nodes.fence.url"), "https://bmc.example.com")}
            {text("systemId", t("nodes.fence.systemId"), t("nodes.fence.systemIdHint"))}
            {text("user", t("nodes.fence.user"))}
            {password}
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <Field id={id("caPem")} label={t("nodes.fence.caPem")}>
                <textarea
                  id={id("caPem")}
                  rows={3}
                  spellCheck={false}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  value={row.caPem}
                  onChange={(e) => onChange({ caPem: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs break-all outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:bg-input/30"
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox
                id={id("insecure")}
                checked={row.insecure}
                onCheckedChange={(v) => onChange({ insecure: v === true })}
              />
              <Label htmlFor={id("insecure")}>{t("nodes.fence.insecure")}</Label>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {row.kind === "command" && (
          <>
            {text("off", t("nodes.fence.off"), t("nodes.fence.offHint"))}
            {text("status", t("nodes.fence.status"), t("nodes.fence.statusHint"))}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

/** `fence-test`의 결과: 방법마다 읽은 전원 */
function TestResult({ test }: { test: FenceTest }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <p className="text-sm">{t("nodes.fence.checkedBy", { name: test.checked_by })}</p>
      <Table aria-label={t("nodes.fence.testResult")}>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>#</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.fence.kindColumn")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.fence.power")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.fence.error")}</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {test.methods.map((m, i) => (
            <TableRow key={i}>
              <TableCell>{i + 1}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{t(`nodes.fence.kinds.${m.kind}`)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{t(`nodes.fence.powerState.${m.power}`)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs break-all text-destructive">{m.error ?? ""}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
it("sets up power-off fencing for a node, then tests it", async () => {
  cluster();
  const witness = { ...NODE, id: "n3", name: "node-w", spec: { ...NODE.spec, witness: true } };
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, DOWN, witness] });
  const put: { ifMatch: string | null; body: unknown }[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence"), () =>
      HttpResponse.json({ code: "not_found", message: "no fencing" }, { status: 404 }),
    ),
    http.put(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence"), async ({ request }) => {
      const body = (await request.json()) as { methods: { kind: string }[] };
      put.push({ ifMatch: request.headers.get("If-Match"), body });
      return HttpResponse.json({
        node: "node-b",
        revision: 3,
        methods: [
          { kind: "command", off: "pdu off b", status: "pdu status b" },
          {
            kind: "ipmi",
            address: "10.0.0.12",
            port: 623,
            user: "admin",
            has_password: true,
            lanplus: true,
          },
        ],
      });
    }),
    http.post(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence-test"), () =>
      HttpResponse.json({
        checked_by: "node-a",
        methods: [
          { kind: "command", power: "on" },
          { kind: "ipmi", power: "unknown", error: "connection timed out" },
        ],
      }),
    ),
  );
  renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Nodes" });
  await within(table).findByText("node-w");
  // 위트니스는 HA VM을 돌리지 않아 펜싱하지 않는다.
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-w" }));
  expect(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Edit labels" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.queryByRole("menuitem", { name: "Power-off fencing…" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await userEvent.keyboard("{Escape}");
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-b" }));
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Power-off fencing…" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Power-off fencing of node-b" });
  expect(await within(dialog).findByText(/No methods/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeDisabled();
  // 저장된 설정이 없으면 시험·지우기가 없다.
  expect(within(dialog).queryByRole("button", { name: "Test" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Add a method" }));
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Add a method" }));
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(within(dialog).getAllByText("Enter a value.")).toHaveLength(4);
  expect(put).toEqual([]);
  const first = within(dialog).getByRole("listitem", { name: "Method 1" });
  await userEvent.type(within(first).getByLabelText("BMC address"), "10.0.0.12");
  await userEvent.type(within(first).getByLabelText("User"), "admin");
  await userEvent.type(within(first).getByLabelText("Password"), "s3cret");
  const second = within(dialog).getByRole("listitem", { name: "Method 2" });
  await userEvent.selectOptions(within(second).getByLabelText("Method 2"), "command");
  await userEvent.type(within(second).getByLabelText("Power-off command"), "pdu off b");
  await userEvent.type(within(second).getByLabelText("Status command"), "pdu status b");
  await userEvent.click(within(second).getByRole("button", { name: "Move method 2 up" }));
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(await screen.findByText("Saved the power-off fencing of node-b.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(put).toEqual([
    {
      ifMatch: null,
      body: {
        methods: [
          { kind: "command", off: "pdu off b", status: "pdu status b" },
          {
            kind: "ipmi",
            address: "10.0.0.12",
            port: 623,
            user: "admin",
            lanplus: true,
            password: "s3cret",
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  ]);
  // 저장한 뒤에는 시험할 수 있고, 저장된 비밀번호는 비워 두면 그대로 둔다.
  expect(within(dialog).getByText("A password is saved. Leave empty to keep it.")).toBeVisible();
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Test" }));
  const result = await within(dialog).findByRole("table", { name: "Test result" });
  expect(within(dialog).getByText("Read by node-a. The power was not changed.")).toBeVisible();
  const rows = within(result).getAllByRole("row");
  expect(rows[1]).toHaveTextContent("1CommandOn");
  expect(rows[2]).toHaveTextContent("2IPMIUnknownconnection timed out");
});

it("keeps the saved password and removes power-off fencing", async () => {
  cluster();
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, DOWN] });
  const saved = {
    node: "node-b",
    revision: 7,
    methods: [
      {
        kind: "redfish",
        url: "https://bmc-b",
        user: "root",
        has_password: true,
        insecure: false,
      },
    ],
  };
  const put: { ifMatch: string | null; body: unknown }[] = [];
  const deleted: (string | null)[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence"), () => HttpResponse.json(saved)),
    http.put(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence"), async ({ request }) => {
      put.push({ ifMatch: request.headers.get("If-Match"), body: await request.json() });
      return HttpResponse.json({ ...saved, revision: 8 });
    }),
    http.delete(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence"), ({ request }) => {
      deleted.push(request.headers.get("If-Match"));
      return new HttpResponse(null, { status: 204 });
    }),
    http.post(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/fence-test"), () =>

  renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Nodes" });

  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Power-off fencing…" }));

  expect(await within(dialog).findByLabelText("BMC URL")).toHaveValue("https://bmc-b");
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Test" }));

            {
              kind: "redfish",
              url: "https://bmc-b",

              system_id: "1",
            },
          ],
        },
      },

  // 저장된 비밀번호를 지우면 빈 글을 보낸다.
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Clear the saved password"));
  expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Password")).toBeDisabled();
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(put).toHaveLength(2));

    body: {

        {
          kind: "redfish",
          url: "https://bmc-b",
          user: "root",
          insecure: false,
          password: "",
        },
      ],
    },

  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove fencing" }));
  expect(await screen.findByText("Removed the power-off fencing of node-b.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(deleted).toEqual(["8"]);
  expect(within(dialog).getByText(/No methods/)).toBeInTheDocument();
});
```

`web/src/nodes/fence.ts`를 만든다:

```ts
import type { components } from "@/api/schema";

type Schemas = components["schemas"];
export type FenceKind = Schemas["FenceKind"];

/** 서버의 `MAX_FENCE_METHODS`·`DEFAULT_IPMI_PORT` */
export const MAX_FENCE_METHODS = 4;
const DEFAULT_IPMI_PORT = 623;

/** 대화상자의 방법 한 줄. 종류마다 쓰는 칸만 보낸다. */
export interface FenceRow {
  kind: FenceKind;
  /** ipmi `address` 또는 redfish `url` */
  address: string;
  port: string;
  user: string;
  /** 비면 저장된 비밀번호를 둔다(같은 종류·주소·사용자일 때). */
  password: string;
  /** 서버에 비밀번호가 저장되어 있는지(연 때) */
  hasPassword: boolean;
  /** 저장된 비밀번호를 지운다(빈 글을 보낸다). */
  clearPassword: boolean;
  lanplus: boolean;
  systemId: string;
  caPem: string;
  insecure: boolean;
  off: string;
  status: string;
}

export function emptyRow(kind: FenceKind): FenceRow {
  return {
    kind,
    address: "",
    port: String(DEFAULT_IPMI_PORT),
    user: "",
    password: "",
    hasPassword: false,
    clearPassword: false,
    lanplus: true,
    systemId: "",
    caPem: "",
    insecure: false,
    off: "",
    status: "",
  };
}

/** 응답의 방법을 대화상자의 줄로 */
export function fromView(m: Schemas["FenceMethodView"]): FenceRow {
  const row = emptyRow(m.kind);
  switch (m.kind) {
    case "ipmi":
      return {
        ...row,
        address: m.address,
        port: String(m.port),
        user: m.user,
        hasPassword: m.has_password,
        lanplus: m.lanplus,
      };
    case "redfish":
      return {
        ...row,
        address: m.url,
        user: m.user,
        hasPassword: m.has_password,
        systemId: m.system_id ?? "",
        caPem: m.ca_pem ?? "",
        insecure: m.insecure,
      };
    case "command":
      return { ...row, off: m.off, status: m.status };
  }
}

/** 줄을 PUT 본문의 방법으로. 빈 비밀번호는 빼서 저장된 값을 두고, 지우기면 빈 글을 보낸다. */
export function toMethod(r: FenceRow): Schemas["FenceMethod"] {
  const password = r.clearPassword
    ? { password: "" }
    : r.password !== ""
      ? { password: r.password }
      : {};
  switch (r.kind) {
    case "ipmi":
      return {
        kind: "ipmi",
        address: r.address.trim(),
        port: Number(r.port),
        user: r.user.trim(),
        lanplus: r.lanplus,
        ...password,
      };
    case "redfish":
      return {
        kind: "redfish",
        url: r.address.trim(),
        user: r.user.trim(),
        insecure: r.insecure,
        ...(r.systemId.trim() !== "" && { system_id: r.systemId.trim() }),
        ...(r.caPem.trim() !== "" && { ca_pem: r.caPem }),
        ...password,
      };
    case "command":
      return { kind: "command", off: r.off, status: r.status };
  }
}

/** 칸의 입력 오류(`<줄>.<칸>` → 번역 키). 나머지는 서버가 본다. */
export function fenceErrors(rows: FenceRow[]): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const need = (field: keyof FenceRow, value: string) => {
      if (value.trim() === "") {
        errors[`${i}.${field}`] = "nodes.fence.errors.required";
      }
    };
    if (r.kind === "command") {
      need("off", r.off);
      need("status", r.status);
      return;
    }
    need("address", r.address);
    need("user", r.user);
    if (r.kind === "ipmi") {
      const port = Number(r.port);
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(r.port) || port < 1 || port > 65535) {
        errors[`${i}.port`] = "nodes.fence.errors.port";
      }
    } else if (r.address.trim() !== "" && !/^https?:\/\/\S/.test(r.address.trim())) {
      errors[`${i}.address`] = "nodes.fence.errors.url";
    }
  });
  return errors;
}
```

`web/src/settings/HaSection.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { useSettings } from "@/api/live";
import type { Settings, SettingsPatch } from "@/api/types";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import { patchSettings, settingsError } from "@/settings/save";

type ReserveKind = "none" | "nodes" | "percent";

/** 서버의 범위: 노드 1~8대, 1~90%, 동시 시작 1~32(기본 4) */
const RESERVE_MAX: Record<Exclude<ReserveKind, "none">, number> = { nodes: 8, percent: 90 };
const MAX_CONCURRENCY = 32;
const DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 4;

interface HaValues {
  kind: ReserveKind;
  amount: string;
  concurrency: string;
}

/** 저장된 설정의 폼 값. 예약·동시 시작은 기본이면 저장하지 않으므로 없으면 기본이다. */
function fromSpec(spec: Settings["spec"]): HaValues {
  const reserve = spec.ha_reserve;
  const kind: ReserveKind = !reserve ? "none" : "nodes" in reserve ? "nodes" : "percent";
  const amount = !reserve ? "" : "nodes" in reserve ? reserve.nodes : reserve.percent;
  return {
    kind,
    amount: String(amount),
    concurrency: String(spec.ha_start_concurrency ?? DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY),
  };
}

function intIn(value: string, min: number, max: number): boolean {
  const n = Number(value);
  return /^\d+$/.test(value) && n >= min && n <= max;
}

/** 입력 오류(번역 키). 없으면 빈 객체 */
export function haErrors(v: HaValues): Partial<Record<"amount" | "concurrency", string>> {
  return {
    ...(v.kind !== "none" &&
      !intIn(v.amount, 1, RESERVE_MAX[v.kind]) && { amount: `settings.ha.errors.${v.kind}` }),
    ...(!intIn(v.concurrency, 1, MAX_CONCURRENCY) && {
      concurrency: "settings.ha.errors.concurrency",
    }),
  };
}

/** 폼 값의 설정 바꾸기 */
export function haPatch(v: HaValues): SettingsPatch {
  const amount = Number(v.amount);
  return {
    ha_reserve:
      v.kind === "none" ? "none" : v.kind === "nodes" ? { nodes: amount } : { percent: amount },
    ha_start_concurrency: Number(v.concurrency),
  };
}

/** HA 용량 예약과 대상 노드당 동시 시작 수. 리더가 쓰는 클러스터 설정이다. */
export function HaSection({ write }: { write: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const settings = useSettings();
  // 고치기 전에는 서버의 값을 보인다(watch로 바뀌어도 따라간다).
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState<HaValues | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<ReturnType<typeof haErrors>>({});

  if (!settings.data) {
    return null;
  }
  const current = fromSpec(settings.data.spec);
  const values = edited ?? current;
  const revision = settings.data.revision;
  const change = (patch: Partial<HaValues>) => setEdited({ ...values, ...patch });
  const unchanged =
    values.kind === current.kind &&
    (values.kind === "none" || values.amount === current.amount) &&
    values.concurrency === current.concurrency;

  async function save(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const errors = haErrors(values);
    setShown(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await patchSettings(queryClient, revision, haPatch(values));
      setEdited(null);
      toast.success(t("settings.saved"));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(settingsError(t, err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(e) => void save(e)} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <h2 className="font-medium">{t("settings.ha.title")}</h2>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <Field
        id="settings-ha-reserve"
        label={t("settings.ha.reserve")}
        hint={t("settings.ha.reserveHint")}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <NativeSelect
            id="settings-ha-reserve"
            value={values.kind}
            disabled={!write || busy}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const kind = e.target.value as ReserveKind;
              change({ kind, amount: kind === "none" ? "" : kind === "nodes" ? "1" : "25" });
            }}
            {...a11y}
          >
            {(["none", "nodes", "percent"] as const).map((k) => (
              <NativeSelectOption key={k} value={k}>
                {t(`settings.ha.reserveKind.${k}`)}
              </NativeSelectOption>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        )}
      </Field>
      {values.kind !== "none" && (
        <Field
          id="settings-ha-amount"
          label={t(`settings.ha.amount.${values.kind}`)}
          error={shown.amount}
        >
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="settings-ha-amount"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={RESERVE_MAX[values.kind as Exclude<ReserveKind, "none">]}
              value={values.amount}
              disabled={!write || busy}
              onChange={(e) => change({ amount: e.target.value })}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
      <Field
        id="settings-ha-concurrency"
        label={t("settings.ha.concurrency")}
        error={shown.concurrency}
        hint={t("settings.ha.concurrencyHint")}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <Input
            id="settings-ha-concurrency"
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={MAX_CONCURRENCY}
            value={values.concurrency}
            disabled={!write || busy}
            onChange={(e) => change({ concurrency: e.target.value })}
            {...a11y}
          />
        )}
      </Field>
      {write && (
        <div>
          <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={busy || unchanged}>
            {t("settings.ha.save")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
it("reserves HA capacity and sets the concurrent starts", async () => {
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/settings"), () => HttpResponse.json(DEFAULT)),
    http.patch(apiUrl("/settings"), async ({ request }) => {
      const body = (await request.json()) as {
        ha_reserve: { nodes: number };
        ha_start_concurrency: number;
      };
      sent.push(body);
      return HttpResponse.json({
        ...DEFAULT,
        revision: 5,
        spec: {
          ...DEFAULT.spec,
          ha_reserve: body.ha_reserve,
          ha_start_concurrency: body.ha_start_concurrency,
        },
      });
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<SettingsPage />);
  // 저장하지 않은 기본: 예약 없음, 동시 시작 4
  const reserve = await screen.findByLabelText("Capacity reserved for HA recovery");
  expect(reserve).toHaveValue("none");

  expect(concurrency).toHaveValue(4);
  const save = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save HA capacity" });
  expect(save).toBeDisabled();
  await userEvent.selectOptions(reserve, "nodes");
  const nodes = screen.getByLabelText("Nodes (1–8)");
  await userEvent.clear(nodes);
  await userEvent.type(nodes, "9");
  await userEvent.clear(concurrency);
  await userEvent.type(concurrency, "0");
  await userEvent.click(save);
  expect(screen.getByText("From 1 to 8.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.getByText("From 1 to 32.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(sent).toEqual([]);
  await userEvent.clear(nodes);
  await userEvent.type(nodes, "1");
  await userEvent.clear(concurrency);
  await userEvent.type(concurrency, "8");

    expect(sent).toEqual([{ ha_reserve: { nodes: 1 }, ha_start_concurrency: 8 }]),

    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save HA capacity" })).toBeDisabled(),

});
```

```tsx
it("sets the recovery priority and the guest watch", async () => {
  const bodies = editStoppedApp();
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("switch", { name: "High availability (HA)" }));
  const priority = screen.getByLabelText("Recovery priority");
  expect(priority).toHaveValue(50);
  await user.clear(priority);
  await user.type(priority, "101");
  // 초 칸은 감시를 켤 때만 보인다(기본 60초).
  expect(screen.queryByLabelText("Seconds without an answer")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: "Restart when the guest hangs" }));
  const secs = screen.getByLabelText("Seconds without an answer");
  expect(secs).toHaveValue(60);
  await user.clear(secs);
  await user.type(secs, "5");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(screen.getByText("From 0 to 100.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.getByText("From 30 to 3600 seconds.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(bodies).toHaveLength(0);
  await user.clear(priority);
  await user.type(priority, "90");
  await user.clear(secs);
  await user.type(secs, "30");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(bodies).toHaveLength(1));
  expect(bodies[0]?.spec.ha).toEqual({
    state: "started",
    max_restart: 1,
    max_relocate: 1,
    priority: 90,
    guest_watch: { timeout_secs: 30 },
  });
});
```

---

## 완료 기준 (계획 51)

- 기본 프로필에서 노드 kill -9·망 끊기·SIGSTOP 뒤 HA VM이 25초 안에 다른 노드에서 켜진다(`ha-it`, 이 Mac 약 12초).
- `NodeFence`가 있는 노드는 리스가 끊기고 `fence_after` 뒤 꺼지고, 꺼짐이 확인되면 `recover_after`를 기다리지 않고 복구된다. 끄기가 실패하면 watchdog 기다림으로 물러나고 `node-power-off` Task에 남는다.
- 복구는 우선순위 순서이고 대상 노드마다 `ha_start_concurrency`를 넘지 않으며, `ha_reserve`를 넘는 HA VM 켜기는 409 `ha_capacity`다.
- 같은 노드 첫 크래시는 지연 없이, 게스트가 `timeout_secs` 넘게 답하지 않으면 다시 켜진다.
- `cargo fmt`, `clippy -D warnings`(모든 기능), `cargo test --workspace`, `ha-it`, 웹 시험이 이 Mac과 svc01에서 통과한다.

## 알고 받아들인 제한

- 리스 갱신이 1초로 늘어 리더 부하가 커졌다(계획 47 규모 시험 표를 다시 잴 것).
- 복구 우선순위는 한 노드 안에서만 지킨다.
- 게스트 감시의 `guest_ping`(최대 3초)은 그 VM의 작업자를 붙잡는다.
- 리더가 바뀌면 동시 시작 기록이 비어 한 번 상한을 넘을 수 있다.
- 실제 BMC(IPMI·Redfish)와 진짜 watchdog 10초에서의 데몬 재시작 여유는 자동 시험이 없다.
- 업그레이드하면 `[ha]`를 적지 않은 노드가 `fast`가 된다(옛 동작은 `profile = "safe"`).
